svg.data-port-modes-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ (brochure and product page, the four combo ports); no module list is printed
svg.data-port-modes-qsfp: 40G QSFP+ (brochure); no module or breakout list is printed
svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, 50 - 60 Hz, two inputs, built-in dual-redundant supplies, nominal 12 V and 10.8 A
svg.data-combo-ports: four combo ports, each a 2.5G RJ45 jack and a 10G SFP+ cage of which only one can be used at a time
